verdict.rationale: Gladia's live STT quickstart separates partial from final transcripts and states the finality rule: partials are provisional, and finals complete an utterance. Configurable silence thresholds and maximum utterance duration add context on when an utterance is finalized. Missing for 10: documented message schema or field-level flags marking partial versus final events, detail on whether finals can be revised, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, streaming results distinguish interim from final transcripts, with the finality semantics documented

citations.quote: Partial transcripts are provisional; final transcripts complete an utterance.
Configure silence thresholds and maximum utterance duration in Gladia live transcription.
